Post-snowball greenhouse. Cap carbonates.

Cambrian. Warm and ice-free.

Late Cretaceous cooling. K-Pg impact winter (66 Ma) is years long; below frame resolution.

Eocene cooling.

Middle Miocene cooling. Antarctic ice expands.
